scope: Feasibility of the unchanged official RepoDoc C component extractor as a description-generation baseline; no new clustering, behavior graph or call-state research
inputs: Previously exposed, versioned public portable-core slices; not new blind repositories
truth_boundary: Independent Ctags definition-location agreement, not compiler-verified whole-OS ground truth; disagreements are not automatically semantic errors
stop: One extraction run, no model calls, no patch to the author extractor to improve its agreement; original errors or dependency failure retained
quality_boundary: No generated documentation and no statement that extractor agreement proves summary quality or paper benefit
